move_rules_as_built: Nothing moves until the owner answers: the engine's week and day reads write nothing (tests/api/test_moves_once_and_reads_write_nothing.py).

Each answer is a write through the outbox. A swap, a carry, a shift and a redo carry an id the phone mints (action_id, a ULID); the engine applies an id once (training_screen.once, the newest 200 ids kept in config 'applied_actions'), so an answer sent again after a lost reply moves nothing twice. Gate 1's answers need none (kept per week).

Every move goes through scheduling.apply_schedule_change (plan.reject_violating_overrides, Key Rule 18b): refused whole, never clamped. A refusal comes back as a 409 with the rule's own words; the page says why, and OK clears that answer (only a schedule answer can be cleared: a refused session or check-in keeps what was typed).
A question answered stays closed until a read newer than the answer; while it waits to send, it says so. Start waits until today's session is read again after a swap, a carry or a shift.
A 'no' is remembered by the engine (scheduling.declined_entries): the question does not come back.
The same yoga or outdoor save sent again answers as it did the first time; another save of it is told it is already logged.
